title: Manual Topic Intake — Request
description: Input to the 'Manual Topic Intake' reusable n8n workflow (Step 5). Answers only 'should this topic become a content project?' — no research, no LLM calls. See docs/architecture/topic-intake.md. This is the PUBLIC contract; the dev test webhook accepts one additional, undocumented, testing-only field (_dev_fail_after_step) not part of this schema — see topic-intake.md#resume-behavior.

topic.description: Raw, un-normalized topic text. Rejected if empty after trimming — see validate_manual_topic().

requested_publish_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp. Stored only — no scheduling is implemented by this workflow.

source_origin.description: Reserved for future automated-discovery callers of the same underlying create_manual_topic_project() path — always 'manual' for this workflow.
